sentences.text: Kunja Behari Lall & Ors vs Unknown on 18 September, 2023

Author: Tirthankar Ghosh
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh
18.09.2023 Serial no. 5 [G.S.D] Crr 3207 of 2023 In the matter of : Kunja Behari Lall & Ors.
... ... Petitioners Md. Ashraf Ali ...

For the petitioner Mr. Arijit Ganguly Mr. Sanjib Kr. Dan ... for the
State Supplementary Affidavit filed by the petitioners be kept with the record.

Let a copy of the Supplementary Affidavit along with a copy of this revisional application be served
upon Mr. Arijit Ganguly, Learned Advocate for the State.

Let a copy of the revisional application along with a copy of the supplementary affidavit be also served upon the o.p.no.2 by speed post with a/d and file affidavit-of-service on the next date fixed for hearing.

Ld. Advocate for the petitioners submits that there are documents under Section 207 of the Cr.P.C.
on which the prosecution has attempted to establish their case under Section 498A of the IPC, prima facie, no offence has been made out so far as the present petitioners are concerned.

Having regard to the fact that charge-sheet has already been submitted and the document under section 207 of the Cr.P.C. has been filed, further the date has been fixed for consideration of charges on 6 th of November, 2023, I am of the opinion that the revisional application is required to be heard out on merits in presence of both the parties.
Ld. Advocate for the State would produce the case diary on the next date fixed for hearing.
List the revisional appliation under the heading 'Contested Application' in the Monthly List of November, 2023.

Pending hearing of this revisional application further proceedings of Kharagpur (T) P.S. Case No.
557 of 2017 dated 17.11.2017 be stayed till 30th of November, 2023.
Parties to act on a server copy of this order duly collected from the official website of the Hon'ble High Court at Calcutta.

(Tirthankar Ghosh, J.)
